import pathlib,json,sys,numpy as np
root=pathlib.Path('/opt/data/private/YuanQi_Q1')
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'script/supermimic_q1_analysis'))
import build_support_projection as build
from inspect_reference_dynamics import identity,container_guard,configured_model
baseline=container_guard(reserve=896*1024**2)
import mujoco as mj
admission=json.loads((root/'data/supermimic_for_q1/R03_B128_extend12000_20261023/run/admission.json').read_text())
manifest=json.loads(pathlib.Path(admission['motion_manifest']['path']).read_text())
row=[r for r in manifest['motions'] if r['clip']=='058_punch_front_alternating'][0]
model,feet,floor,caps,meshes=configured_model(root,admission,mj)
with np.load(row['output']['path'],allow_pickle=False) as saved: source={k:saved[k].copy() for k in saved.files}
mapping=json.loads((root/'script/supermimic_for_q1/retarget_mapping.json').read_text())['body_map']
with np.load(row['kinematic_trace']['path'],allow_pickle=False) as saved:
    targets=saved['target_position_m_world'].copy();targets[:,:,2]+=row['diagnostics']['global_ground_origin_shift_m']
    ids=[model.body(mapping[name]).id for name in saved['source_body_names'].tolist()]
before,before_summary=build.geometry(model,feet,floor,source['qpos'],source['qvel'],source['body_names'].tolist(),ids,targets,mj,baseline['oom_kill'])
shift,solver=build.support_shift(before['foot_gap_m'].min(axis=1))
poses,speeds=build.shifted_states(source['qpos'],source['qvel'],shift,.02)
after,after_summary=build.geometry(model,feet,floor,poses,speeds,source['body_names'].tolist(),ids,targets,mj,baseline['oom_kill'])
changed_count=np.flatnonzero(before['self_contact_count']!=after['self_contact_count'])
depth_difference=np.abs(before['self_contact_depth_m']-after['self_contact_depth_m'])
changed_depth=np.flatnonzero(depth_difference>1e-10)
old,new=mj.MjData(model),mj.MjData(model)
translation_error=rotation_error=0.
for i in range(len(poses)):
    if i%128==0: container_guard(baseline['oom_kill'])
    old.qpos[:]=source['qpos'][i];new.qpos[:]=poses[i]
    mj.mj_kinematics(model,old);mj.mj_kinematics(model,new)
    dz=poses[i,2]-float(source['qpos'][i,2])
    expected=old.geom_xpos.copy();expected[:,2]+=dz
    translation_error=max(translation_error,float(np.max(np.abs(expected-new.geom_xpos))))
    rotation_error=max(rotation_error,float(np.max(np.abs(old.geom_xmat-new.geom_xmat))))
examples=[]
for i in np.unique(np.concatenate([changed_count,changed_depth]))[:12]:
    contacts=[]
    for data,q,v in ((old,source['qpos'][i],source['qvel'][i]),(new,poses[i],speeds[i])):
        data.qpos[:]=q;data.qvel[:]=v;mj.mj_forward(model,data)
        contacts.append([{'geoms':[int(c.geom1),int(c.geom2)],'bodies':[model.body(int(model.geom_bodyid[g])).name for g in (c.geom1,c.geom2)],'distance_m':float(c.dist),'active':bool(c.efc_address>=0)} for c in data.contact if floor not in (c.geom1,c.geom2)])
    examples.append({'frame':int(i),'time_s':float(source['time_s'][i]),'old_count':int(before['self_contact_count'][i]),'new_count':int(after['self_contact_count'][i]),'old_depth_m':float(before['self_contact_depth_m'][i]),'new_depth_m':float(after['self_contact_depth_m'][i]),'old_new_contacts':contacts})
report={'status':'PUNCH_TRANSLATION_INVARIANCE_DIAGNOSED','source':identity(root/'script/supermimic_q1_analysis/build_support_projection.py'),'reference':row['output'],'frames':len(poses),'count_changed_frames':changed_count.tolist(),'depth_changed_frames':changed_depth.tolist(),'maximum_depth_difference_m':float(depth_difference.max()),'all_geom_translation_error_m':translation_error,'all_geom_rotation_error':rotation_error,'before':before_summary,'after':after_summary,'examples':examples,'health_before':baseline,'health_after':container_guard(baseline['oom_kill']),'new_physics_steps':0,'new_inverse_calls':0,'new_policy_inference':0,'new_optimizer_updates':0}
output=root/'logs/supermimic_q1_D05_punch_invariance_probe_20261024.json'
with output.open('x') as stream:json.dump(report,stream,indent=2,allow_nan=False);stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(report,allow_nan=False))
print(json.dumps({'receipt':identity(output)}))

import pathlib,json,sys,numpy as np
root=pathlib.Path('/opt/data/private/YuanQi_Q1');sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'script/supermimic_q1_analysis'))
from inspect_reference_dynamics import identity,container_guard,configured_model,bottom_point
from build_support_projection import support_shift
baseline=container_guard(reserve=896*1024**2)
import mujoco as mj
admission=json.loads((root/'data/supermimic_for_q1/R03_B128_extend12000_20261023/run/admission.json').read_text())
probe_path=root/'logs/supermimic_q1_D05_punch_invariance_probe_20261024.json'
probe=json.loads(probe_path.read_text())
model,feet,floor,caps,meshes=configured_model(root,admission,mj)
with np.load(probe['reference']['path'],allow_pickle=False) as saved:qpos=saved['qpos'].astype(float)
old,new=mj.MjData(model),mj.MjData(model);lower=[]
for q in qpos:
    old.qpos[:]=q;mj.mj_kinematics(model,old)
    lower.append(min(bottom_point(model,old,ids,mj)[0] for ids in feet))
shift,solver=support_shift(lower)
moving=np.flatnonzero(model.geom_bodyid!=0)
assert np.all(model.body_rootid[model.geom_bodyid[moving]]==model.body('pelvis').id)
translation_error=rotation_error=0.
for i,q in enumerate(qpos):
    if i%128==0:container_guard(baseline['oom_kill'])
    old.qpos[:]=q;new.qpos[:]=q;new.qpos[2]+=shift[i]
    mj.mj_kinematics(model,old);mj.mj_kinematics(model,new)
    expected=old.geom_xpos[moving].copy();expected[:,2]+=shift[i]
    translation_error=max(translation_error,float(np.max(np.abs(expected-new.geom_xpos[moving]))))
    rotation_error=max(rotation_error,float(np.max(np.abs(old.geom_xmat[moving]-new.geom_xmat[moving]))))
report={'status':'ROBOT_GEOMETRY_TRANSLATION_VERIFIED','original_probe':identity(probe_path),'reference':probe['reference'],'moving_geometries':len(moving),'excluded_world_geometries':np.flatnonzero(model.geom_bodyid==0).tolist(),'robot_geom_translation_error_m':translation_error,'robot_geom_rotation_error':rotation_error,'model_ccd_tolerance_m':float(model.opt.ccd_tolerance),'observed_depth_difference_m':probe['maximum_depth_difference_m'],'count_changed_frames':probe['count_changed_frames'],'frames':len(qpos),'new_physics_steps':0,'new_inverse_calls':0,'new_policy_inference':0,'new_optimizer_updates':0,'health_before':baseline,'health_after':container_guard(baseline['oom_kill']),'note':'The first all-geom error included the fixed world floor, which must not translate. This check covers every robot geometry and excludes only world-body geometries.'}
assert translation_error<1e-12 and rotation_error<1e-12
out=root/'logs/supermimic_q1_D05_robot_geometry_probe_20261024.json'
with out.open('x') as stream:json.dump(report,stream,indent=2,allow_nan=False);stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(report));print(json.dumps({'receipt':identity(out)}))
note: Historical executed commands; preserve original outputs and use new output names for any deliberate reproduction. The first all-geom comparison includes the fixed floor; only the second probe proves robot-geometry translation.
